about: The Workbench icons of the Simutrans drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/port_icons.py amiga/icons/icons.json --out amiga/icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). The art (art/simutrans.svg, drawn as an OS 3.5 GlowIcon: shaped, shaded, see-through round the edges) is The AmiCradle Team's own, under the same terms as the other Amiga files; art/simutrans.png is it rendered at 128 x 128. Simutrans-drawer.info is the drawer's own icon, Simutrans.info beside the drawer; it has its own name here so as not to meet the program's Simutrans.info. ReadMe.info serves ReadMe, LICENSE.txt and readme.txt.
